description: The TicTacToe hall (room 62, hallA): sitting at a table starts a game alone (OPENGAMEBOARD), a second player joins it mid-game, CHOOSETYPE (the other player gets the other side, TYPERESERVED), SETSECTOR (not your turn, wrong side, taken square, out of the board), five in a row wins (winning tokens, the chat line), no moves after the end, RESTART, a bad game id, walking off the table and leaving the room mid-game (CLOSEGAMEBOARD)
